'''2003 Georgia State Championship Brian Rippetoe DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Rippetoe]] at [[2003 Georgia State Championship]]; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Brian "X-Zipher" Rippetoe (2003-05-24).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=28964 Bring Him Before Me - The Beast]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060517222610/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=28964&PHPSESSID=86426c7a683a4b1b886b16770023580d Internet Archive]</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Bring Him Before Me - The Beast'''
* '''Author:''' Brian "X-Zipher" Rippetoe
* '''Published:''' May 24, 2003
* '''Rating:''' 4.79
* '''Description:''' My 3-0 Atlanta States Deck

=== Strategy ===

This deck was not built to cross, it was built to beatdown the opponent but in most games in altanta I did cross for the win.  Tip if you try to win by crossing you never will go for beatdowns all game and if part way through the game if you have the cards to make it happen and want to try and win the game quicker go for it but dont messup your current game plan.  It can secondly be used if your backed into a corner to win I did this against the Judge at Atlanta I got beatdown in space because I unestimated his space package, late game he had me outnumber 2 to 1 on cards left and i manuevered one final battle that I could win to get the 3 card stacked cause he play jedi luke he i battle win battle get card  lose maul to put phantom menace back in deck move to ds2 db next turn activate phantom menace as only force move to throne room duel he lose 3 force next turn i actate all but three  he win duel i draw 7 I deplete him of 20 cards.

Ok Card Choices

Mobilization Points why no combo dont do that again incase of the random insert

Ket Maliss (V) gets me the dirty rat

Crush The Rebellion gets evader(for trm) and I have you now for huge destinys

Emperors power this is huge in this deck you get basically tow destiny in every battle with the sabers that means usually battle damage.

3 Alters all premier yes this deck does not like sense, revo, goo, bacta

P-60? another way to hit  rogue 1

Nute Gunray? yes nute he is destiny 3 deploy 3 power 3 forfiet 6 good numbers gets two destiny of even 3 if sidiuos in on corrscant DB

Dengar in Ship sinks homeone alone cause of emp power and great againt Xwings

Spaceport DB mainly it can goto Naboo

Mara Jada with the emperor always in play she is a spy for 5 and power 6 and two destiny she = get and easy card from yoda sitting at the council chambers

Ok Matchups

TRM

this is what this was built for first shield use use make it oppresive so your stuff ok dont cancel the first revo with evader i just gets grapped then u screwed dont deploy and battleground db just build up on the ds2 under the emp power deploy bonus and deploy the db and move to it when u have a huge crew they dont realy want to messup if you have too much power and are guaranteed several destiny they will prob give u luke take him and start dueling. The key in this match is dont goto ground till u can hold it you space package can take care of theirs with little trouble. And look at you deck every turn to see what you activated.

Speeders

You have the p droids to shoot down speeders you have the dirty rat to steal u have i have you now to kill luke once and some speeders they dont have the greatest destiny in the world if they keep puttin luke on a speeder everyturn you will need to use emp power so u can kill him and a speeder this will be a long game but u should only be losing 1 character per battle or a stolen speeder you have crossfire which works with 6 different characters or you can alter it.  Monnok can big huge for u in this game.  Wait to go to space till you have dengar if it is xwings.

Wys get the blast door conrtol before you goto space the dirty rat should be hugein this match up as well they also lose luke possibly or they will lose 3 a turn and 1 retrieval just play smart try to always kill the pilot and the ship

Anything else play smart go for the beats and if its combat put the spaceport DB on naboo against Hyperdirve put it on Tat anything else carida usually, and every onecin a while corrscant.

This deck went 3-0 in atlanta states vs trm,HB flip, and tatooine Beats. Have fun with it, it is a very fun deck to play,its kinda like playin dark in the old days
